I will do this plot much like last season, only I will keep the spending where I know it pays. On maize here, I have seen people get a better harvest when they plant bought seed and put one bag of fertilizer on a plot this size, so I will do that, and I will also carry some manure because this land is mine. I will not irrigate, and I will not buy spray for this plot; we will weed by hand and with the hoe. Because I am old and I have other land too, my family will work here, but I will also hire some men for the heavy work.
